subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this issue require both Control UI and native WebChat URL linkification before it can close, or should maintainers narrow the first fix to Control UI and track native parity separately?
rationale: The Control UI repair shape is clear, but the issue title/body also name WebChat as applicable, and automation should not decide whether a web-only fix satisfies the broader user request.

options.title: Narrow to Control UI first
options.body: Implement and prove the full Control UI tool-output surface now, then split native WebChat parity into a separate follow-up if maintainers still want it.

options.title: Require full parity
options.body: Keep this issue open until both Control UI and native WebChat render safe clickable links in tool output.

options.title: Treat WebChat as out of scope
options.body: Document the request as web-only and close only after Control UI behavior is implemented and proven.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Control UI first
recommendation.body: Implement and prove the full Control UI tool-output surface now, then split native WebChat parity into a separate follow-up if maintainers still want it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the maintainer-side scope review and has recent ownership signals on the current UI paths.
